mapper.select: SELECT j.user_id, j.task_id, j.job_id, j.plan_version, j.node_key, j.worker_key, j.worker_version, j.status AS job_status, p.status AS plan_status, j.binding_id, b.agent_id, j.input_json, j.cancel_requested_at, j.guard_token, j.guard_lease_until, j.result_candidate_json, j.candidate_guard_token, j.candidate_turn_id FROM sq_worker_job j JOIN sq_plan p ON p.task_id = j.task_id AND p.plan_version = j.plan_version JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = j.user_id AND b.binding_id = j.binding_id WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} AND j.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND b.role = 'WORKER'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_worker_job j SET j.status = 'RUNNING', j.guard_token = #{guardToken}, j.candidate_guard_token = CASE WHEN j.result_candidate_json IS NOT NULL THEN #{guardToken} ELSE j.candidate_guard_token END, j.guard_lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, j.version = j.version + 1 WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} AND j.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND j.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND (j.status = 'READY' OR (j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.guard_lease_until < #{now})) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_plan p WHERE p.task_id = j.task_id AND p.plan_version = j.plan_version AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET result_candidate_json = #{resultJson}, candidate_guard_token = #{guardToken}, candidate_turn_id = #{turnId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND guard_token = #{guardToken} AND guard_lease_until > #{now} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND result_candidate_json IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_plan p WHERE p.task_id = sq_worker_job.task_id AND p.plan_version = sq_worker_job.plan_version AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_json = result_candidate_json, guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND candidate_turn_id = #{turnId} AND candidate_guard_token = guard_token AND guard_lease_until > #{now} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_plan p WHERE p.task_id = sq_worker_job.task_id AND p.plan_version = sq_worker_job.plan_version AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'RECONCILING', 'CANCELLING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_plan p WHERE p.task_id = sq_worker_job.task_id AND p.plan_version = sq_worker_job.plan_version AND p.status = 'SUPERSEDED')
UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'FAILED', guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
